summary: The main article describes the synthesis of a photocatalytic Ru-functionalized MOF (UiO-67-Ru(bpy)3) and its application in the aerobic oxidation of arylboronic acids. The document includes a synthesis scheme, characterization data via PXRD and NMR, and two tables detailing reaction optimization and substrate scope.

items.heading: Scheme 1
items.caption: Synthesis of UiO-67-Ru(bpy)3 using three different synthetic strategies.
items.description: This scheme illustrates the three synthetic routes (Direct, PSE, and PSM) attempted to incorporate the Ru complex into the UiO-67 framework.

items.heading: Fig. 1
items.caption: PXRD (top) and 1 H NMR (D3PO4/DMSOd 6 digested, bottom) of UiO-67-Ru(bpy)3 containing different amount of Ru complex.
items.description: The figure displays the powder X-ray diffraction patterns and NMR spectra used to confirm the crystallinity and Ru loading of the modified MOFs.

items.heading: Table 1
items.caption: Summary of results for the aerobic oxidative hydroxylation of arylboronic acids using UiO-67-[Ru(bpy)3]0.1 as catalyst a
items.description: This table presents the optimization of reaction conditions, including control experiments for light, atmosphere, and catalyst type.

items.heading: Table 2
items.caption: Scope of substrate conversion using UiO-67-[Ru(bpy)3]0.1 as catalyst
items.description: This table details the yields for various arylboronic acid substrates converted to phenols under UV and visible light irradiation.
